title: MyVector — real-dataset benchmark
subtitle: MySQL 8.4 / 9.7 / 26.10 + MariaDB 12.3 · fashion-mnist-784 · published ground truth
description: MyVector across MySQL 8.4 / 9.7 / 26.10 on a real dataset (fashion-mnist-784-euclidean vs published ground truth): each version's scalar baseline vs its current-main build (PR #278 + #280). The -opt curves were re-measured 2026-11-10 on current main (controlled: cores 12–15, cache-above-index); the scalar baselines are the original pre-optimization measurements. Current-main MyVector is consistent across all three versions (~2.7k QPS at ef=10, recall 0.975), a ~4–5× lift over the scalar baseline.
caveats: The -opt curves are current main (#278+#280), re-measured 2026-11-10 under controlled conditions (cores 12–15, HNSW graph in memory, 500 queries/point). The plain 8.4/9.7/26.10 curves are the original scalar baselines (pre-#278) kept as the 'before'. The scalar→opt gap therefore reflects the optimizations and the move from the original to controlled measurement conditions.

Consistent across versions: current-main MyVector performs essentially identically on 8.4, 9.7 and 26.10 (ef=10 ~2667–2696 QPS, recall 0.975) — the optimizations are version-independent (same rewrite + kernels).
MariaDB 12.3 is included as a native-vector reference (same fashion-mnist, published GT).
Dataset / params: fashion-mnist-784-euclidean, HNSW M=16, ef_construction=200. Recall@10 vs published neighbors. Headline cards = warm ef_search=200. A1 host.
